definition: Consent is a freely given, clear agreement to take part in a specific sexual activity. It must be voluntary, informed, specific and ongoing, and it can be withdrawn at any time.
details: Consent must be voluntary, informed, and can be withdrawn at any time. Silence, a past 'yes', being in a relationship or marriage, or how someone is dressed is not consent. Someone who is asleep, unconscious or very drunk can't consent. Agreeing to one thing doesn't mean agreeing to everything. If someone says no or seems unsure, stop — don't pressure.
answer_guidance: Explain the meaning directly and naturally. Match the user's language and writing style. If the user only asks for the meaning, begin with a concise definition. Give additional explanation when the user asks for more detail. Keep the tone respectful and non-graphic. Consent applies in every relationship, including marriage.
